verdict.rationale: SES supports templated messages with personalization tags (docs-4, docs-20, docs-37) which implies sending many personalized emails in a scalable way, and community evidence notes it is used for mass/marketing sending (comm-3, comm-10). However, the evidence pack never documents an explicit bulk/batch send API (e.g., SendBulkEmail), throughput/rate quotas for bulk campaigns, or first-party guidance for looping over many recipients in one call, so the bulk-operation story is only weakly implied. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-send API documentation, batch size/quota limits, and hands-on confirmation of large-scale bulk sends succeeding.
